features.method: DERIVED line from sourced positions along a sourced direction, anchored to the ground by the constraint set described below; no map shape was traced. From the WGTS coil-system centre (z = -38.87 m) to the detector coil-system centre (z = +13.78 m) of Table 1 in src:geo-kit-katrin-aircoil-2013, that is 52.65 m, along the bearing 16 deg. It does not reach the ~70 m overall length of the setup (src:geo-kit-katrin-tdr-2004, src:geo-kit-katrin-design-paper) because the rear section upstream of the WGTS and the detector system downstream of its coil are not given positions in any fetched source. PLACEMENT (the same for the axis and the vessel footprint). Direction: the KATRIN Collaboration writes 'The experiment has an orientation of xi ~ 16 deg east to the local north N' (src:geo-kit-katrin-lorentz-2022); the long sides of the OSM KATRIN outline (way 394890935) run at 15.8-16.1 deg, which is independent agreement, not an input. Positions along the axis: Table 1 of src:geo-kit-katrin-aircoil-2013 gives the centres of the coil systems relative to the centre of the main spectrometer (z = 0): WGTS -38.87 m, DPS -27.25, CPS -20.58, pre-spectrometer coils -16.46 and -12.10, pinch coil +12.18, detector coil +13.78. Where z = 0 lies on the ground is NOT published; it was bounded by three facts: (1) the main spectrometer vessel, 23.23 m long and 9.8 m in diameter (src:geo-kit-katrin-design-paper), lies inside the OSM KATRIN outline; (2) the detector coil (z = +13.78 m) lies inside the same outline; (3) the WGTS (z = -38.87 m) stands in Tritium Laboratory building 452 ('Rear system and WGTS will be installed in the existing TLK building'; 'The Tritium Laboratory (building 452)'; src:geo-kit-katrin-tdr-2004) whose OSM outline is way 99082477. In the 16-degree frame (a along the axis, b to the left, origin 49.0957 N 8.4360 E) the outline is a 53 m x 19 m stepped polygon; scanning z = 0 over a 0.25 m grid, the placements satisfying (1)-(3) span a = -13.3 to +14.0 m and b = -1.8 to +7.5 m (1806 of the grid points); adding the pre-spectrometer coils inside the outline narrows a to -8.5..+14.0 m, and adding the DPS and CPS (the TDR puts the transport system in a new building that 'will become part of TLK') narrows it to +2.3..+14.0 m. z = 0 is drawn at the centre of the set (a = 6.4 m, b = 3.0 m, i.e. 49.0957631 N, 8.4359846 E); the largest distance from it to any feasible placement is 19.7 m, hence accuracy_m 20. Everything relative (the 52.65 m between coil-system centres, the 16 deg direction) is sourced; the absolute position inside the hall is not. Haversine measure of the drawn line: 52.644 m on R = 6371008.8 m.

summary.plain: The KIT Campus North site near Karlsruhe, drawn to scale with the building outline around the KATRIN spectrometer hall, the Tritium Laboratory buildings, and the KATRIN beam axis and main spectrometer placed inside the hall along the published direction (about 16 degrees east of north). The axis is positioned to within about 20 m.

unlocated.backlog: A surveyed KATRIN coordinate (the centre of the main spectrometer or of the WGTS in the KIT north-campus system, from a geodetic or alignment paper), or a dimensioned plan of the spectrometer hall that fixes where the vessel stands in it; then re-anchor both derived shapes and tighten accuracy_m. The monitor-spectrometer hall also needs a source.
unlocated.entity_name: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Campus North
unlocated.reason: The rest of the KATRIN beamline: the rear control-and-monitor section upstream of the WGTS, the detector system downstream of the detector coil (together they make up the 'about 70 m' overall length, against the 52.65 m between the WGTS and detector coil centres that is drawn), the pre-spectrometer, the DPS and CPS as individual elements, and the 5 m monitor beam line with its own monitor-spectrometer hall ('the two setups are separated into two different buildings', design report p. 53). No fetched source gives their coordinates or a surveyed axis; the drawn axis is positioned only to within about 20 m inside the hall by the constraints in its record.
